cases.scenario: Concurrency/retention limits (max open agent sessions and per-delegation-tree max_parallel) were not exercised in the prior round's multi-session runs (only 2 concurrent sessions were ever created per daemon, well under any limit). This case records the limit constants found by reading the source (no build/exec) and a concrete, ready-to-run repro for a later round.
cases.agentOrSurface: HTTP API (POST /v1/agent-sessions) -- source-level analysis only, no daemon run in this task
cases.precondition: None exercised; static read of crates/interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs and crates/interaction-core/src/agent.rs at HEAD 78dcda1a.
steps: Read crates/interaction-core/src/agent.rs: DelegationLimits::default() = {max_depth:3, max_sessions:8, max_messages_per_session:200, max_parallel:4, provider_allowlist:[]}

Read crates/interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs create_agent_session(): for a plain create with NO delegation envelope, `open = open_agent_sessions()`; if `open >= policy.delegation.max_sessions` (default 8) -> Err(DomainError::PolicyBlocked("too many open agent sessions ({open} ≥ {max_sessions})"))

For a create WITH a delegation envelope: check_delegation() enforces max_depth/cycle/budget/max_sessions (agent.rs:143-176); additionally agents.rs computes `same_tree` = count of open sessions sharing the same delegation.root_task_id and rejects with 'delegation tree {root_task_id} already has {same_tree} open sessions (max_parallel {max_parallel})' when same_tree >= policy.delegation.max_parallel (default 4)
PolicyBlocked maps to an HTTP 4xx (exact status not re-verified this task; prior static inventory documents PolicyBlocked as a rejection path, not a 200)

expected.coreState: The 9th concurrent plain agent-session create (no delegation envelope) on one daemon should be rejected with PolicyBlocked citing max_sessions=8; the 5th concurrent create sharing one delegation.root_task_id should be rejected citing max_parallel=4
expected.effect: No new AgentSessionRecord created on rejection; existing 8 (or 4) sessions unaffected

cases.actual: Not run this round (no test exercised >2 concurrent sessions). Classified not-run per task instructions rather than completed/product-failed since no live evidence exists yet -- only source-level static findings, which are not proof of runtime behavior.
evidence: crates/interaction-core/src/agent.rs:121-140 DelegationLimits + Default impl (max_sessions:8, max_parallel:4, max_messages_per_session:200, max_depth:3)
crates/interaction-core/src/agent.rs:145-176 check_delegation() -- max_sessions check at line 171-176

crates/interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs:468-503 create_agent_session() -- non-delegation path 'open >= policy.delegation.max_sessions' at line 496-500; delegation-tree max_parallel check at line 470-491
observations: Two distinct limits exist and are reached via two different code paths: max_sessions (8) applies to ALL open agent sessions on the daemon when NO delegation envelope is supplied on create; max_parallel (4) applies only within one delegation tree (same rootTaskId) when a delegation envelope IS supplied -- a plain multi_session.py-style test (as used for E0-06/E0-07) will only ever hit max_sessions, never max_parallel, since it doesn't set a delegation envelope

Policy values are runtime-configurable (policy.delegation.*), so the effective limit on this daemon should be re-confirmed via GET /v1/status or the policy endpoint before relying on the '8'/'4' defaults for a later run

Repro for a later round (max_sessions=8, no delegation envelope): start an isolated daemon (INTERACT_AI_HOME=<out>/home, INTERACT_AI_MOBILE_ADVERTISE=0, unique port P), then: TOKEN=$(cat <out>/home/state/api-agent-token); for i in $(seq 1 9); do curl -s -o /tmp/r$i.json -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$P/v1/agent-sessions -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"agentId":"codex","label":"limit-'$i'","workdir":"<out>/work-'$i'","ttlMinutes":5}'; done -- expect 200 x8 then a 4xx on i=9 whose body contains 'too many open agent sessions (8 ≥ 8)'.

Repro for max_parallel=4 (same delegation.root_task_id, distinct hop_count/visited_sessions per hop): create 5 sessions each with a 'delegation' envelope object sharing one rootTaskId and incrementing hopCount/visitedSessions; expect the 5th to be rejected with 'delegation tree {root_task_id} already has 4 open sessions (max_parallel 4)'. Exact DelegationEnvelope JSON shape should be re-derived from crates/interaction-core/src/agent.rs's serde(rename_all=camelCase) fields (delegationId, originAgentId, hopCount, maxHops, visitedSessions, budgetRemaining) before running.
